messages:
laura: Heads-up — p99 for model-x jumped ~80ms after the kernel swap last night. Coincident with a shift to larger microbatches and a kv cache miss rate spike. :thinking:

raj: Do you have the timeline? kernel change ts vs rollout window?

laura: kernel rollout at 4305510000, regression starts ~4305522000. Snapshot: p50 unchanged, p95 +30ms, p99 +80ms, kv_miss_rate from 6% -> 14%.

mike: looked at the batch profiler — new kernel prefers coalescing into bigger microbatches when idle tokens available. That increases batch_size mean from 2.1 -> 6.8 for short seqs. KV locality suffers because more interleaving across requests.

mike: Paste from profiler: ```histogram(batch_size) pre: {1:46%,2:30%,3+:24%} post: {1:12%,2:20%,3:68%}```

sylvia: Larger batches are great for throughput but we need to protect latency-sensitive routes. Suggest we try a hybrid admit policy that gates on both token_budget and kv_locality. If kv_locality < threshold, tighten token_budget.

raj: Agreed. Also want a soft probabilistic reject ramp instead of hard 429s immediately — smoother fallbacks to smaller kernel or lower-quant model.

laura: Sketch of policy I had in mind: ```
admit_policy: hybrid_kv_token
  token_budget_target: 400  # tokens per batch window
  kv_locality_threshold: 0.65 # fraction of requests in batch that hit cache
  probation_ms: 120
  soft_reject_prob_base: 0.05
  soft_reject_prob_mult_on_miss: 2.0
  max_soft_reject_prob: 0.6
```

laura: Behavior: if kv_locality < threshold, increase soft_reject_prob exponentially over probation_ms, and reduce token_budget_target by 25% while in probation. Probabilistic rejects return lightweight soft-reject (503+Retry-After hint) or trigger immediate fallback to small-kernel path.

mike: We should be explicit about returns — prefer soft-reject (early returning syntactic partial) vs 429. 429 used today means client-level retry flooding. Soft-reject type we want: internal SLO-aware decline that hints route-level fallback. Something like 4995 (internal soft-reject) so SDKs can map to fallback.

raj: +1. Also add a short probe lane: allow 1 in N requests through to test if kv_locality recovers. That avoids perpetual blackout.

dan: For observability, add these metrics: `admit_soft_reject_rate`, `kv_locality_ratio`, `batch_size_mean`, `tokens_per_batch`, `kv_miss_rate`, `p99_latency_ms`, `soft_reject_probe_success_rate`. Dashboards + alerts: p99 up 25ms or kv_miss_rate > 10% triggers rollback.

perf-bot: Experiment template created: /experiments/hybrid-kv-token/430555 — toggle keys: `hybrid_kv_token_enabled`, `soft_reject_mode`, `probe_fraction`. Rollout API: `curl -X PATCH https://controlplane/featureflags -d '{"hybrid_kv_token_enabled":true,"probe_fraction":0.01}'`.

infra-bot: Note: changing admit policy touches queue admission path. Plan to stage on canary pool only, min 3h observation. CPU/GPU sched metrics will also be collected automatically.

laura: Plan: 1) Implement gating + probe lane (mike) 2) Add telemetry and dashboard (dan) 3) Create experiment and start 1% canary for 3h (raj) 4) SDK mapping for soft-reject (sylvia) 5) Postmortem if regression continues (laura).

mike: Implementing today — will push config flags behind `hybrid_kv_token_enabled`. Quick rollout patch: ```
// admit_router config snippet
hybrid_kv_token:
  enabled: false
  params:
    token_budget_target: 400
    kv_locality_threshold: 0.65
    probation_ms: 120
    probe_fraction: 0.01
```

mike: Also adding a tiny hot-path optimization: fast-path when `kv_locality_ratio >= 0.9` to keep current high-throughput batching.

raj: Rollout checklist: canary only on model-x, observe p99, kv_miss, 429 and soft_reject_count. Abort if p99 > baseline + 30ms or kv_miss_rate increases by >5pp.

sylvia: SDK change: treat soft-reject response code `4995` as a signal to retry on fallback route instead of exponential backoff retry. We'll add mapping in the client next patch. :shipit:

laura: I'll own the dashboard and final go/no-go. Thanks all. I'll post results after the 3h canary. :eyes:

raj: If canary looks clean we can try ramping to 10% with the same thresholds and 1% probe_fraction to keep recovery checks.

laura: Action items summarized: mike implement + tests, dan dashboard, sylvia SDK mapping, raj run canary, laura monitor + decide. Meeting if abort.

mike: Will open PR and link here when ready.

perf-bot: PR: https://git.internal/pr/7890 — includes admit policy, metrics, unit tests.

laura: Great. Thanks everyone.

infra-bot: Reminder: update runbook doc if new response code 4995 is introduced.
